_comment: Copy to ~/.config/agent-dashboard/config.json (or set CHIEF_DASHBOARD_CONFIG_HOME to a directory containing config.json) and edit for your machine. Nothing here is loaded from this example file directly.

remote._comment: See server/REMOTE.md: off unless enabled. A SEPARATE listener binds on 127.0.0.1:<port> only when enabled — point `tailscale serve` at that port, never at the main dashboard port above. Generate the token with scripts/remote-token.py. `hosts` is only the Origin allow-list for CSRF, never a Host-header identity check.
